findings.finding: Two consecutive extracted-model segments show pale upright/extended/upright stalks (14:40,14:50,15:00), then brown upright/extended/upright stalks (15:20,15:30,15:40). The extreme foreground bulb at 15:30 is plausibly the distal end of a projected stalk, but the basal connection is not readable at 120x90. The only intervening cards contain internal filenames, not an unambiguous Toadstool/Whitestool label. The description lists both names without timestamps, and its list order is not a reliable segment map. Assigning the brown segment to Toadstool and pale segment to Whitestool would therefore remain an inference; native gameplay similarity is complementary but does not solve this identification.
